description: This Java source file defines the StaticDispatcherServlet class, a specialized Spring DispatcherServlet used within the OpenMRS project to handle static content. It manages initialization and refresh of the servlet context, including class loader setup and lifecycle management for the static content dispatcher.

classes.name: StaticDispatcherServlet
classes.description: A custom servlet extending Spring's DispatcherServlet for managing static content within OpenMRS, providing methods for initialization, context refresh, and shutdown.

methods.name: initFrameworkServlet
methods.description: Initializes the servlet, setting the proper class loader and registering the servlet instance for later use.

methods.name: refreshApplicationContext
methods.description: Refreshes the servlet's application context, typically invoked after module updates.

methods.name: stopAndCloseApplicationContext
methods.description: Stops and closes the servlet's application context, handling exceptions internally.
